{{Top}}
'''Zaffa oil''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food additive]].<ref name="A Very Special Meal">{{WEGCite|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook|story=A Very Special Meal}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="SotES">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> the exclusive [[Manarai]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] prepared meals with it. [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Fendrilon Koozar]] once ordered [[Fleek eel/Legends|fleek eel]] broiled in zaffa oil. [[Guri]] visited the Manarai and ordered [[Master Chef]] [[Tavvar Va'ran]] to give Koozar the "house special," which was a code to prepare a meal that would undetectably [[Poison/Legends|poison]] the diner through combinations of ingredients and chemicals in conjunction with their own digestive system. As Koozar was [[Human/Legends|Human]], one of Va'ran's preparations that caused [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Death/Legends|death]] was [[collafa spice]] in the zaffa oil.<ref name="A Very Special Meal" />
